children: LME copper (MCU3=LX) may test resistance at $14,527 per metric ton this week, a break above which could lead to a gain to $14,888.

A channel technique indicates a target around $14,600, while a projection analysis suggests a higher target of $14,888. A projection analysis suggests a wave c from $12,997 may either end around its 61.8% level of $14,527 or extend to $15,473.
These bullish targets will be aborted, if the market closes below the August 27 low of $14,160.
* The copper report is published weekly on Monday.
